items.html: And behold, the secret of this point, its matter is that it is indeed known how the two luminaries were, in their emanation, created equal in stature one to the other. And when the moon diminished herself, meaning: that which was in the secret of a complete Partzuf was diminished and stood in the secret of a small point containing the ten Sefirot, and the other nine points flew away from her, as is known — that her root at first is only one point, and afterward nine other points came to her as additions through ZA. For this reason she is called 'a mirror that has nothing of her own.' Therefore ZA took them back, and she remained in the secret of a small point. And then she could not stand next to him because of her great smallness, and then she descended to this place, at the head of Beriah.
